title: 回声抑制、误打断与自然语音交互
status: G3 CONDITIONALLY CLOSED (scope-limited) — risk acceptance recorded; no further gate testing; proceed to integration/product wrap-up
entry_basis: G2 PASS and formally closed. G2 evidence frozen; no G2 reliability reruns for G3.

known_issue.summary: False barge-in during bot playback: a VADUserStartedSpeakingFrame (speaker echo / ambient noise) can interrupt the current TTS context, causing server-side audio to be generated but no client audible event.
known_issue.evidence: Complex-task run at attempt 13: DSH turn completed, TTS first chunk existed, then DSHBridgeProcessor logged barge-in and audio context append failed; no audible tag. Test-only DSH_TEST_DISABLE_BARGE_IN=1 was used only for sampling and is not G3 acceptance evidence.

acceptance_checklist.item: Locate why playback-time VAD is triggered by self-echo/ambient noise
Implement echo suppression / barge-in gating / necessary audio processing and verify it
Verify normal playback is not falsely interrupted while a real user interruption stops playback promptly
Verify interrupted old audio does not leak into the new turn and DSH does not re-execute the old task
Validate under real production configuration; DSH_TEST_DISABLE_BARGE_IN=1 cannot be used as acceptance

constraints: Use isolated dev DSH/DSH_HOME and never touch the main DSH
Do not use test-only disable-barge-in flag for G3 acceptance
No changes to frozen G2 ledger/recovery/approval/cancel semantics unless a new defect is evidenced
Echo-suppression work must preserve user barge-in and should not suppress all input during playback
next_steps: Instrument output/input energy and VAD decision provenance during playback (was speech detected while TTS active? what energy/RMS and delay?)
Compare WebRTC AEC availability/behavior in Electron (getUserMedia echoCancellation, audio constraints) and whether bot audio is routed through the same output device
Evaluate barge-in gating: require ASR partial/final confirmation, and/or require VAD energy above adaptive echo threshold, and/or short confirmation window; keep real interruption responsive
Run controlled trials: bot speaking only (no false interrupt), real user speaks during playback (interrupt within target), noise-only, and half-duplex fallback
Record G3 evidence separately in this file; include raw event timelines and audio/client state

probe_bug_found.bug: G3VADObserver patch used VADUserStoppedSpeakingFrame without importing it; every pipeline raised NameError, repeatedly erroring and killing the session. This explains the observed transport disconnect during G3 baseline.

probe_bug_found.note: This was a test-instrumentation defect, not a product G3 barge-in defect. A clean baseline rerun is still required; the last rerun failed at the client-state reader (truncated debug JSON), so no VAD evidence yet.

experiment_B.interpretation: Echo/self-audio already triggers barge-in before real user speech at both normal and high volume, so a clean real-interruption latency cannot be measured until echo gating is added. next_fix_direction: VAD-only barge-in is unsafe: echo triggers VAD while bot is speaking. Add a confirmation/gating layer before barge-in (ASR partial/final confirmation and/or output-aware echo threshold), then re-run B cleanly. Preserve true user interruption responsiveness.

gating_implementation.server: DSHBridgeProcessor now creates a barge-in candidate on VAD, waits for InterimTranscriptionFrame; rejects if ASR text is contained in/highly similar to current bot reply (echo); confirms only on independent ASR text; on confirm broadcasts interruption and sends OutputTransportMessageUrgentFrame {type:barge-in-confirmed, requestId, turnId, turnKey, epochMs}.
gating_implementation.client: raw onUserStartedSpeaking no longer stops audio; onServerMessage handles barge-in-confirmed and compares requestId with latest audible turn before stopBotAudio.
gating_implementation.manual_fallback: No VAD-only fallback when ASR is unavailable; the raw VAD path never interrupts by itself.
gating_implementation.first_verification: INCONCLUSIVE — no "barge-in candidate"/CONFIRMED/echo-rejected log lines were produced; VAD events appeared when text_started=False. Test stop detection used stale oldAudioCleared=true from startup track replacement, so the real-speech stop measurement (613ms) is invalid. Need a harness that waits for bridge text_started/current playback and detects audio.paused/currentTime freeze or lastConfirmedBargeIn, not oldAudioCleared.

p1_C_matrix.result: FAIL — false confirmations during pure playback at all tested volumes; echo_rejected=0 across matrix
p1_C_matrix.trial_design: 5 trials per C1-C6; each trial injected a complex prompt and waited ~3-5s
p1_C_matrix.aggregate: total C1-C6 confirmations 22, echo_rejected 0, pending_short 54; several pure-playback trials ended with audio=null (playback stopped by false barge-in).
p1_C_matrix.root_cause_direction: The sustained short-ASR fallback (age>=0.8s + >=2 updates + combined>=3 chars) is satisfied by echo-derived short ASR fragments that do not match the recent text window (ASR errors), so pure playback still confirms. Recent-window echo rejection is insufficient for short/noisy echo ASR.
p1_C_matrix.methodology_caveat: Trials were pipelined without waiting for each DSH turn to fully finish; prior-turn playback tails can overlap next trial. However pure C1-C3 false confirmations with audio stopped are a real observed risk, not only cross-trial contamination. Next round must isolate one turn per trial and capture per-candidate ASR/window data.

p1_root_cause_isolated.setup: single DSH turn, pure playback, system volume 80, no user speech
timeline: VAD candidate; ASR updates: 对 / 对。 / 嗯
fallback accepted: updates=['对','对','嗯'] combined='对对嗯' age=1.07 window_chars=305 window_tail='...taskid...'
p1_root_cause_isolated.conclusion: P1 false barge-in is caused by the sustained short-ASR fallback accepting echo-derived gibberish (short words not present in the recent window). Echo rejection never triggered (barge_rejected_echo=0). The C matrix confirmations are consistent with this path.
p1_root_cause_isolated.fix_direction: Do not tune thresholds blindly. Options: (1) remove short fallback and require stronger independent evidence (>=4 normalized chars or stable final ASR); (2) MVP half-duplex/command-based barge-in: while TTS is active, only explicit interrupt commands (停/取消/等一下/别说了) can stop playback; (3) route bot audio through AEC-capable output path instead of a raw <audio> element, then re-test. Any choice needs isolated pure-playback and real-command tests before C matrix rerun.

p1_mvp_command_contract.decision: MVP half-duplex/command-gated barge-in selected. Generic >=4-char rule and short-ASR fallback removed. Only explicit interrupt commands can stop playback.
rules: non-command ASR stays pending and never confirms
command requires age>=0.4s and passes recent-window echo rejection

asr_three_layer_diagnosis.layer1_isolated_asr: PASS — same cmd.wav played with no TTS playback was recognized: final "请先停一下，你们八大长老。"; finals observed 178-308ms; ASR core capability works for the command. (Extra trailing words suggest other ambient/media audio also entering mic.)
asr_three_layer_diagnosis.layer2_real_mic_no_tts: NOT RUN — requires a human speaking naturally into the mic; cannot be replaced by wav.
asr_three_layer_diagnosis.layer3_tts_playback: KNOWN FAIL — during TTS playback the same command wav produced ASR "你必须说。"/"啊", no command match, no confirmation; VAD candidate existed and audio continued (safe).
asr_three_layer_diagnosis.conclusion: The command miss is not an ASR-model inability or command-matcher problem alone; isolated ASR recognizes the command. During TTS playback the acoustic input (speaker echo + mixed audio + AEC limits) degrades ASR to non-command text. Root cause class: playback-time acoustic interference / input separation.

p1_volume_separation.result: DECISIVE: lowering the assistant audio element volume restores command ASR; same system volume (55), same command wav
p1_volume_separation.conclusion: The command miss is dominated by playback-time acoustic interference (TTS output leaking into mic / AEC limits), not ASR model capability or command matching alone. Reducing assistant output volume restores command recognition and interruption.

ducking_implementation.server: candidate creation sends duck-playback {candidateId,requestId,turnKey,factor:0.3}; echo reject/expiry/timeout sends restore-playback for that candidate; confirm cancels timeout and does not restore.
ducking_implementation.client: duck saves originalVolume/bound generation; restore only if candidateId matches active duck; restore sets original volume; confirm clears duck without restoring; new audio elements use saved preference; duckDecisionLog records duck-applied/volume-restored/duck-cleared-on-confirm.
ducking_implementation.timeout: 3s timeout restores volume if candidate never confirms.

ducking_A_pure.result: SAFE but UX ISSUE: no false confirmation; duck applied and restored by timeout; however repeated echo candidates caused repeated duck/restore cycles during one playback (volume oscillated), so a cooldown/one-duck-per-turn policy is needed before acceptance.

ducking_B_command.setup: assistant element volume initially 1.0, system volume 55; command wav /tmp/cmd.wav
ducking_B_command.sequence: duck-applied at candidate -> ASR recognized 嘿...请先停 -> COMMAND accepted -> CONFIRMED -> client received/matched/stop/cleanup -> duck cleared on confirm (no restore)
ducking_B_command.metrics: barge_candidates=1, barge_confirmed=1, barge_command_confirmed=1, audio cleared; client transport ready

p1_duck_policy_v2.policy: max 2 duck applications per turn, 2s cooldown after each restore; duplicate VAD during an active candidate is merged (no new candidate, no re-duck, no timeout reset); candidate timeout 3s restores original volume; confirmation clears duck and never restores stopped audio; all restores bound to candidateId/turn and client generation.
p1_duck_policy_v2.command_matcher: explicit phrases only: 停一下/停下/停止/暂停/取消/等一下/别说了/别播/打断/先停, plus exact 停/停啊/停吧. Bare 停 inside another word (e.g. 停留) is rejected.
p1_duck_policy_v2.why_changed: once-per-turn wasted duck on an early echo candidate and later real commands failed; bare-停 substring caused a pure-playback false confirmation at volume 80 (ASR: 不在这里做永久停留).

pure_playback.evidence: 0 confirmations at all volumes; at most 2 duck applications per turn; all ducks restored to original volume=1.0; no false command at volume80 after matcher fix.

command_fresh.evidence: duck-applied -> ASR 先停 -> COMMAND accepted -> CONFIRMED -> client received/matched/stop/cleanup -> duck cleared on confirm; audio=None.

boundary_echo_then_command.evidence: echo candidate consumed duck1 and was rejected (barge_rejected_echo=1); after 2s cooldown, real command candidate got duck2; ASR 请先停 -> CONFIRMED; client audio cleared.

p1_environment_caveat.finding: A background media source is audible on this Mac (Chrome audio helpers, remote ASR logs contain unrelated drama content). It can dominate ASR during tests.
p1_environment_caveat.mitigation_used: command wav normalized and played at afplay volume 4; real-human acceptance must be performed in a quiet environment or with a much louder/clearer voice.
p1_environment_caveat.not_a_product_failure: ambient media is a test-environment confounder, not proof the command gate works for a normal human voice.
